title: Rav Zutrai
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: He is mentioned in Shabbat 124b, objecting to Rav Yehudah’s words in Shmuel’s name. Hyman reports Mar Zutra from Dikdukei Soferim and Rav Zutra from all the old printings, attributing the Zutrai form to a corruption in the Frankfurt am Main printing.[^1][^2]

notes.text: The William Davidson digital Shabbat 124b paragraph reads Rav Zutra. Hyman’s statement about all old printings and the Frankfurt am Main corruption is his bibliographic report; those printing pixels have not been inspected here.

The checked Shabbat 124b paragraph names Rav Zutra in the objection. Hyman’s Zutrai heading, reported Mar Zutra apparatus reading, statement about all old printings and attribution of corruption to the Frankfurt am Main printing remain separately attributed. No printing census or history of the corruption was performed.
